summary: All endpoints move from /v1/... to /v2/... with FleetSnapshot.api_version "v1" -> "v2" (v1 deprecated, shut off 2026-12-01). TelemetryFrame.orientation changes from Euler degrees roll/pitch/yaw (intrinsic Z-Y-X) to unit quaternion qx,qy,qz,qw (Hamilton, scalar last) for the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Scalar noise (isotropic 1-sigma, metres) is replaced by required 6x6 covariance, and required health (0..1) is added with alert below 0.5.

fields_removed.notes: Removed isotropic 1-sigma position uncertainty, metres. Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. A scalar equivalent of the old noise is sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3) where P_pos = covariance[0:3][0:3] in m².

Removed degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X; same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) now encoded as unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last. Build rotations from quaternion directly; do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

Removed degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X; same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) now encoded as unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last. Build rotations from quaternion directly; do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

Removed degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X; same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) now encoded as unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last. If you still need heading, use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

fields_added.notes: Added 6x6 symmetric pose covariance as nested row-major arrays. Variable order x, y, z (m) then rotation about X, Y, Z (rad). The position block covariance[0:3][0:3] is in m². Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. Scalar equivalent sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3).
Added required composite localisation/drive health 0..1; 1 = nominal; values below 0.5 mean the robot should be serviced. Ops dashboards should raise a health alert below 0.5.

Added unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll). Server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. If heading needed: yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.
